integrity: The proof reduces minimum generation in the generalized dihedral group to completion of tuples in the abelian kernel, uses Sylow Frattini quotients to obtain necessary and sufficient pair conditions, counts each degree prime by prime, and proves order divisibility using invariant-factor valuations. The packaged replay exhaustively reconstructs the graph for two nontrivial higher-rank kernels, including a non-elementary p-group and a mixed-Sylow example.
scientific_limitations: The kernel is finite abelian of odd order and has minimum generator number at least two.
The complement has order two and acts by inversion.
The cyclic-kernel two-generated case is excluded from the novelty domain.
The theorem resolves the degree-divisibility question only for this generalized-dihedral family.
title: Minimum-size independence graphs of odd generalized dihedral groups
